softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
We implemented a Magento application to provide a full end-to-end shopping experience, from browsing and payment to final delivery. The platform supports multiple product formats—including whole beans, ground coffee, and pods—and handles payments securely through Stripe.


The store is deeply integrated with the company’s SAP ERP, ensuring every online order is automatically reconciled against warehouse inventory. The system also supports customer loyalty programs and deferred payment options, bridging the gap between a consumer-friendly shopping experience and the complexity of premium retail operations.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: Karam Coffee, a premium Emirati roastery serving local and global markets.
softwarePortfolioLayout.testimonialContent: Our online platform has successfully bridged the gap between digital consumer convenience and our complex warehouse operations. The integration with our SAP core functions flawlessly, giving us real-time control over our inventory.
